envelope.sourceCitation: FAA, Contact Medical Certification, Aerospace Medical Certification Division, "Special Delivery" (last updated May 23, 2023). Notes quote the FAA Guide for Aviation Medical Examiners (Authority of Aviation Medical Examiners, last updated September 27, 2023; Special Issuance, last updated August 28, 2024) and the FAA Medical Certification Questions and Answers brochure (OK-24-1154, 10/02/2024); the courier suggestion is AOPA's ('How and where to submit to the FAA').

contactNote: Phone (405) 954-4821 · Fax (405) 954-4300 (fax only 20 pages or less, with no ECG tracings or images).
mailingNotes: AOPA suggests a courier service that provides signed proof of delivery (overnight or registered mail).
The FAA says: "Reports regarding the medical status of an airman should be written by their treating provider. A report written by an airman will not be accepted, even if that airman is a physician."
The FAA asks you to have your designated AME upload the required information, or "have all of the information forwarded to us in one package."
The FAA says: "The Authorization letter is accompanied by attachments that specify the information that treating physician(s) must provide for the re-issuance determination."
